nodeRemoval.title: Remove {name}
nodeRemoval.description: This stops access and removes this node from squad bindings, endpoints and saved routing choices. Empty plans are disabled. Routing credentials and accounting are drained before enrollment is revoked. Historical traffic and financial evidence are retained.
nodeRemoval.done: Removed from active inventory. Historical accounting is retained.

blockers.XNODE_REMOVAL_OFFLINE: Reconnect this node to prove its final accounting barrier. Admission remains disabled.
blockers.XNODE_REMOVAL_PENDING_ACCOUNTING: Accounting has an unfinished barrier or gap. Admission remains stopped; removal will resume after reconciliation.
blockers.XNODE_REMOVAL_ROUTING_PENDING: Waiting for affected nodes to revoke routing credentials. Removal will resume automatically.
blockers.XNODE_REMOVAL_SYNC_PENDING: Waiting for synchronization or final accounting. Removal will resume automatically.
blockers.XNODE_REMOVAL_INPUT_INVALID: Removal could not validate stored configuration. Review the node configuration before retrying.

nodeAdmin.reloadHint: Normal reload rechecks material and keeps unchanged listeners. Forced recovery restarts the runtime.
nodeAdmin.validationUnavailable: Validation is unavailable. Retry before saving.
